meta.scope: official Train rows only (3360); Train-sub 2856 / Dev 504
meta.label_policy: non-Train label entries are masked to NaN immediately after loading and are never used

split.assignment_rule: sorted scaffold keys -> numpy default_rng(seed).permutation -> greedy add whole groups while not exceeding the target
split.scaffold_definition: rdkit Bemis-Murcko, acyclic molecules keyed by their own SMILES

definitions.exact_type: (word_a, word_b, cut bond raw 3-column attributes); the pair directory's pair_transform
definitions.coarse_type: (radius-1 identity of word_a, radius-1 identity of word_b, cut bond raw attributes); ACRA local identity of the attachment site
definitions.context_full: exact environment fragment C (the matched context; canonical coloured rooted fragment, up to 8 atoms)
definitions.context_r2: ACRA C identity: radius-2 ball around the environment attachment atom in G - cut bond
definitions.context_r1: ACRA S identity of the reverse directed event: radius-1 ball around the environment attachment atom in G - cut bond
definitions.independent_unit: one distinct full context; pair components and scaffolds are reported as molecule-level dependence checks
definitions.label_scope: support is label-free and restricted to official Train rows

thresholds_train_support.note: n_molecule/scaffold/component_incidences are per-type counts summed across types and are not unique across types; use unique_units_train_support for the deduplicated counts.

strict_independence_train_support.definition: contexts >= k, pair components >= 2, and scaffolds >= 2 within the type

notes: The full context C is the matched environment and the finest independence unit; radius-1 and radius-2 identities are nested coarsenings.
For exact types, max pairs per (type, full context) is 1, so full contexts and pairs coincide; for coarse types a coarse type can contain several exact types under different full contexts.
Pair components are connected components of the matched-pair graph containing at least one pair endpoint; isolated molecules are not counted.
No Valid/Test row or label is used; the scope is the official Train set only.
